business: Bowlista, a 100% pure-veg bowls, burritos, subs and cold brew outlet
target: BBD University students in Lucknow, 18 to 24, who eat out or order in several times a week
where: Crown Mall, Faizabad Road, near BBD campus, Lucknow

segments.name: Hostel or PG student from out of town (income = annual spending money in rupees)
Day scholar living with family in Lucknow (income = annual pocket money in rupees)
Well-off student who eats out often (income = annual spending money in rupees)

behaviours.name: Mess-food escaper
behaviours.how: Skips the hostel mess or PG food several times a week and looks for something cheap and filling.

behaviours.name: Coupon hunter
behaviours.how: Orders on Swiggy or Zomato only when there is a discount, compares final price after delivery fees.

behaviours.name: Group hangout
behaviours.how: Goes to the mall with friends after class; the group picks the place together.

behaviours.name: Loyal to the canteen or dhaba
behaviours.how: Has a regular spot near campus for chai, maggi, chole bhature or thali, and rarely tries new places.

behaviours.name: Late-night orderer
behaviours.how: Orders food to the hostel late at night while studying or gaming.

behaviours.name: Fitness-minded
behaviours.how: Goes to the gym, counts protein, prefers food that feels lighter or healthier.

behaviours.name: Trend chaser
behaviours.how: Tries new cafes early and posts them on Instagram stories.

behaviours.name: Checks ratings first
behaviours.how: Will not try a place under 4 stars on Zomato or without friends recommending it.

objections: A ₹69 mini will not fill me up, so I will end up spending more
The canteen or dhaba near campus is cheaper and closer
Bowls and burritos are not my kind of food; I want something desi and spicy
Veg-only means no chicken, and my friends want non-veg
Delivery fees and packaging charges make it expensive on the apps
New places start good and the portions shrink after a month
Going to Crown Mall between classes is a hassle
Cold brew sounds overpriced for a student
habits: you have about an hour between classes at lunch
your monthly money runs low in the last week of the month
you hang out at Crown Mall with friends on weekends
you order food to your room at least twice a week
you split bills with friends using UPI
you go home for festivals and weekends sometimes
